$comment: The compatibility record for the Munarium client libraries. Generated and maintained by hand at release time. Update this file, never the historical notes in README.md, which are a dated changelog of what was true when they were written.
policy: Each Clients minor release supports the current Server minor and the one before it (N and N-1). A breaking MMP wire change bumps mmp_contract_major; Server serves both majors for one Server minor release so Clients can move without a flag day. Clients version independently of Server: a shared version number on a given release is a coincidence of that release, not a rule.
note: Server client source packages 1.4.0 target Server 1.4.0 with the declared N/N-1 range 1.4/1.3, pending release qualification and publication. New platform operations require a Server implementing those operations and its enrolled platform profile; the compatibility range does not backport them to 1.3. Published packages retain their previously qualified ranges. Matrix client compatibility is maintained in iokaio/munarium-matrix. Publish munarium-proto and munarium-api-types 1.4.0 before Rust client 1.4.0. Source versions do not establish registry availability; see the dated publication record in README.md.
